description: Configuration for the CDF pusher (BaseCogniteConfig). Authentication, project, and connection settings belong in connection.yml (see connection_config.schema.json).

cdf-chunking.description: Configure chunking of data on requests to CDF. Note that increasing these may cause requests to fail due to limits in the API itself.

time-series.description: Maximum number of timeseries per get/create timeseries request.

assets.description: Maximum number of assets per get/create assets request.

data-point-time-series.description: Maximum number of timeseries per datapoint create request.

data-point-delete.description: Maximum number of ranges per delete datapoints request.

data-point-list.description: Maximum number of timeseries per datapoint read request. Used when getting the first point in a timeseries.

data-points.description: Maximum number of datapoints per datapoints create request.

data-points-gzip-limit.description: Minimum number of datapoints in request to switch to using gzip. Set to -1 to disable, 0 to always enable. The minimum HTTP packet size is generally 1500 bytes, so this should not be set below 100 for numeric datapoints.

raw-rows.description: Maximum number of rows per request to CDF Raw.

raw-rows-delete.description: Maximum number of row keys per delete request to CDF Raw.

data-point-latest.description: Maximum number of timeseries per datapoint read latest request.

events.description: Maximum number of events per get/create events request.

sequences.description: Maximum number of sequences per get/create sequences request.

sequence-row-sequences.description: Maximum number of sequences per create sequence rows request.

sequence-rows.description: Maximum number of sequence rows per sequence when creating rows.

instances.description: Maximum number of data modeling instances per get/create instance request.

cdf-throttling.description: Configure the maximum number of parallel requests for different CDF resources.

time-series.description: Maximum number of parallel requests per timeseries operation.

assets.description: Maximum number of parallel requests per assets operation.

data-points.description: Maximum number of parallel requests per datapoints operation.

raw.description: Maximum number of parallel requests per CDF Raw operation.

ranges.description: Maximum number of parallel requests per get first/last datapoint operation.

events.description: Maximum number of parallel requests per events operation.

sequences.description: Maximum number of parallel requests per sequences operation.

instances.description: Maximum number of parallel requests per data modeling instances operation.

nan-replacement.description: Replacement for NaN/Infinity double values when writing datapoints to CDF. If omitted, non-finite values are skipped.
